title: Mum asks: voice clone
hook: Mum asked: can AI copy my voice?

beats.say: Mum got a call that sounded exactly like me, asking for money.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta was that you on the phone?? You sounded so worried

beats.say: Yes. A few seconds of your voice online can be enough to copy it.
So pick a family code word. No code word, no money. Then call back on the real number.
I already picked one for you! It is Meera!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta was that you on the phone?? You sounded so worried

Ok. Code word is RASMALAI.
Your father already guessed it.

beats.say: Papa already guessed the code word.

caption:
a voice clone called mum. the committee gave her a code word. papa cracked it in one guess.

would your parents fall for a call like this?

Comment SAFE and I'll DM you the family safety message to send your parents.

#claude #codex #gemini #desimom #aisafety
